credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, Collection of Barney A. Ebsworth, 1998.93.1
description: Two curving black forms arch over the composition. A triangular white form protrudes into the canvas from the lefthand side. A band of bluish black extends from the bottom to the top of the work at its center. Behind these forms, a white background glows as though a light is being shone on it.
